name: Rezicraft – Professional Resume & CV Builder
author: ashiquzzaman

sections.description:
Build a polished, professional resume directly inside your WordPress dashboard. Create shareable, high-quality Resumes & CVs using the Gutenberg block editor with no complex page builders, external tools, or design experience required.

Your resume is the first impression you make on recruiters and potential clients. Rezicraft helps you build a polished, shareable resume directly inside WordPress, without exporting to a third-party builder or with page-builder.

✨ Build Professional Resumes with Gutenberg Block Control

Rezicraft transforms the WordPress block editor into a powerful resume-building canvas. Whether you are a job seeker, a freelancer, already working or a consultant. This plugin helps you design beautiful, responsive resumes that look great on any device.

Forget about formatting issues in Word documents or limited templates in third-party builders. With Rezicraft, your resume is a native WordPress custom post type, giving you full ownership and flexibility.

👩‍💻 Why do you need a WordPress-based Resume Builder?

Own Your Career Data: Keep your resume content on your own domain. No more proprietary editor lock-in or subscription fees for basic updates.

Seamless Integration: Your resume lives on your website, perfect for linking from your portfolio or professional blog.

Professional Output: Template-specific typography and layout CSS ensure your resume is readable, professional, and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Live Previewing: Browse templates and test color palettes in real-time before you commit to a layout.

Shareable Public URLs: Publish your resume with a click and send a clean, professional link to recruiters, hiring managers, or clients.

🎉 Rezicraft is the ultimate Resume Builder for WordPress

Designed for the modern block editor, it offers a WYSIWYG editing experience where you can edit sections, headings, and details effortlessly.

What You Get With Rezicraft –

Designed for WordPress: Resumes are stored as a native custom post type and edited with familiar Gutenberg blocks. No proprietary editor lock-in.

Native Gutenberg Editing: Update your experience, skills, and contact details using the familiar WordPress block interface.

Live preview: Browse templates with real-time color palette filters before you commit to a layout.

Shareable public URLs: Publish a resume and be ready to send to recruiters or link from your portfolio.

Professional Templates: Choose from a variety of layouts designed to showcase your career story effectively.

Unlimited Resumes: Create as many resumes as you need with the General Template for the free version and 16-ATS friendly templates for Pro. For different job applications or freelance niches.

Color Palette Filters: Easily match your resume design to your personal brand or website theme.

No External Tools Required: You don’t need to export or import files from external resume sites. Keep your workflow 100% internal.

Responsive Design: Every resume built with Rezicraft is fully responsive, ensuring recruiters see your best side on any device.

How It Works 🚀 Get Started in Minutes

  1. Browse templates — Open Rezicraft → Templates to preview layouts and adjust appearance filters.
  2. Use a template — Create a draft resume pre-filled with structured sample content you can replace with your own.
  3. Edit in Gutenberg — Update sections, headings, and details using the block editor canvas styled like your published resume.
  4. Publish and share — Publish to enable the public resume URL.

💎 Unlock Advanced Features with Rezicraft Pro

While the free version of Rezicraft provides everything you need to create and publish a stunning resume, our Pro version takes your career tools to the next level:

  • Advanced Color Palettes: Unlock more design customization options.

  • Professional Headshots: Easily upload and manage your professional photo.

  • Custom Backgrounds: Tailor the look and feel of your resume pages.

  • PDF Download: Allow recruiters to save a static copy of your CV.

  • Print Ready: Optimized layouts for high-quality physical printing.

  • Direct Emailing: Send your resume directly to recruiters through your site.

Stop juggling multiple files and external resume builders. Install Rezicraft today and start building the career presence you deserve!

🪄 Designed for Your Professional Workflow

Whether you are just starting your career or you’re an industry veteran, Rezicraft adapts to your needs:

For Job Seekers: Publish a standalone resume page and share one link with hiring managers.

For Freelancers & Consultants: Maintain an always-up-to-date CV directly alongside your portfolio site to win more projects.

For Agencies: Build client resume pages on WordPress without needing to write custom theme code.

For Personal Brands: Keep your career story and your business on the same domain for a cohesive professional presence.

Rezicraft Features

  • General resume template with Gutenberg block editing
  • Public resume URL
  • Unlimited resumes with the General template
  • Blank color palette
  • 10 color palette (Pro)
  • Headshot Image (Pro)
  • Custom Background color (Pro)
  • PDF Download (Pro)
  • Print Ready (Pro)
  • Email To Recruiter (Pro)

Visit the Website for Pro features.

Source Code

Rezicraft follows the WordPress.org human-readable code guideline. Rezicraft-authored JavaScript and CSS ship as readable source under assets/js/ and assets/css/ (no npm/webpack build step).

JavaScript: assets/js/admin.js, assets/js/editor-resume.js, assets/js/view-transition-fix.js
CSS: assets/css/ (admin, palettes, public resume, block-editor typography) and assets/css/templates/ (general.css in the free build)
.

PHP dependencies: run composer install for the Freemius SDK (vendor/freemius/wordpress-sdk/). Some bundled SDK assets are minified upstream — see https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk
sections.installation:
Quick WordPress Installation

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New and search for Rezicraft.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Rezicraft in the admin sidebar to browse templates and create your first resume.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the rezicraft-professional-resume-cv-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Rezicraft → Templates to get started.

Getting Started

  1. Go to Rezicraft → Templates, choose your appearance options, and click Use Template on the layout you want.
  2. Edit the draft resume in the block editor — replace sample text with your experience, skills, and contact details.
  3. Click Publish to enable the public resume URL.
sections.faq:
Who is Rezicraft for?

Rezicraft is ideal for anyone who wants a professional resume hosted on their own WordPress site — job seekers, freelancers, consultants, educators, and agencies building resume pages for clients.

Where are my resumes stored?

Each resume is saved as a rezicraft_resume custom post type entry. You edit content in the block editor like any other WordPress post.

Can I share a resume publicly?

Yes. Publish a resume to get a clean public page. You can share that URL directly.

Does Rezicraft work with my theme?

Yes. Published resumes use a dedicated front-end template designed for readable resume output, independent of most theme layout.

Do I need the block editor?

Yes. Rezicraft is built for Gutenberg. Resumes are edited in the block editor with template-aware styling on the editor canvas.

How many resumes can I create on the free plan?

The free plan includes unlimited resumes with the General template.

Can I download my resume as a PDF?

PDF download and Email to Recruiter are Pro features. Upgrade from Rezicraft → Billing on asphaltthemes.com.

Is Rezicraft translation-ready?

Yes. Rezicraft is prepared for localization and uses the rezicraft-professional-resume-cv-builder text domain throughout the admin and front-end strings.

Where can I get support?

Visit the WordPress.org support forum for community help with the free plugin.

Does Rezicraft load fonts from Google?

The free plan has no font picker and does not connect to Google. Resumes use each template’s built-in typography.
